THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
118
STUDY 144
Fuzzy Purple Crop & Denim Maxi
Rights check
Source: 25050.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy copper-red
hair stands full-length against a white backdrop. She
wears a fuzzy magenta-purple long-sleeve crop top
with a sweetheart neckline, a sheer layer beneath, and
a silver choker. A long vintage denim maxi skirt with
frayed hem and a studded belt, plus a slouchy suede
shoulder bag, complete the outfit. Plush purple slippers
finish the look. Her expression is calm. Soft, even
studio light. Palette of magenta, indigo denim, and
burnt copper. Cozy and playful, in the style of a fall
street-style lookbook.
Cozy, playful, vintage
WORKING NOTES
- The fuzzy texture and denim maxi are the defining
pieces.
- Keep the slippers for a playful, lounge-inspired finish.
Try this: Keep the slippers for a lounge-inspired finish.
